section-about.title: ABOUT ME
section-about.subtitle: Turning ideas into digital reality
section-about.paragraph-1: I am a Front-end Developer with over 3 years of experience building modern, scalable, and product-oriented web applications. Throughout my career, I have contributed to the development of medium and high-complexity systems for companies in the education, healthcare, and technology sectors, primarily using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and React Native. I have experience creating high-performance user interfaces, component-based architectures, API integrations, automated testing, and software architecture best practices, always focused on delivering solutions that generate real value for users and businesses.
section-about.paragraph-2: I believe technology should be used to simplify processes and solve problems efficiently. For this reason, I focus on code quality, user experience, and team collaboration, actively participating in code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous product improvement. In addition to my professional experience, I develop personal projects that allow me to explore new technologies and continuously enhance my skills, keeping up to date with trends and best practices in the Front-end ecosystem.

section-projects.title: PROJECTS

section-projects.description: A selection of my most recent and relevant projects, showcasing my skills across different technologies and business contexts.

card-1.title: AgendaMed
card-1.description: A complete appointment scheduling and management platform for medical clinics. This project was developed with the goal of simplifying appointment scheduling and consultation management, providing better control and organization for healthcare facilities. In addition to appointment scheduling, the system allows the registration of doctors, patients, and medical specialties. It also features a dashboard with charts and reports on scheduled and canceled appointments, enabling more effective monitoring and management. Note: If you would like to test the application, use the following credentials: email: operator@operator.com and password: Operator@123

card-2.title: Prestige Real Estate
card-2.description: A property management system for real estate agencies. This project was developed to create a complete ecosystem for property management, where users with a realtor profile can register properties and make them available for sale or rent. The system also includes customer registration through a form accessible from the login page. After registering, customers can browse the platform, view available properties, and contact real estate agents directly. Note: To test the application, you can create a new account or use the following credentials: email: corretor@corretor.com and password: Corretor@123
card-2.alt-image: Login page image of the Prestige Real Estate project

card-3.title: LibriX
card-3.description: A book management platform for libraries. This project was developed with the goal of creating an efficient system for inventory management, loan, and return of books. The system also allows the creation of user profiles, where readers can view their loans, history, and book reviews. It also features an AI agent that provides book recommendations to users based on their preferences and reading history.
